message:
fix(log-upload): fence late answers by owner epoch; drop the out-of-scope server session persistence

Follow-up to f911845 (P10) after review.

- Scope: server-side session persistence was excluded from this task (auth lifetime is a
  separate scope). server.js returns to in-memory sessions and restart_test.js pins that
  contract (a session does not survive a restart; unknown sessions are refused). Not a
  revert of f911845: the uploader, its tests and the host-token contract tests stay.
- Boundary bug: a late 401 for a request made under the previous owner re-held its batch
  and only skipped the pause; a late 5xx and any answer after a sign-out had no owner
  check at all, so account A's lines could be resent under account B's headers. Now the
  owner is identity + normalised host:port + device; a change or a sign-out bumps an
  ownerEpoch, every send carries it, and an answer for another epoch is discarded without
  touching the pause, the hold or the current credentials. Only a same-owner token
  replacement retries a 401-held batch with the new token.
- Tests: 8 fake-HTTP cases -- the answer to A's request delayed 400 ms, then account /
  server url / device change or sign-out + same-account re-login, answered 401 or 500:
  no old body reaches the new destination, no pause, nothing held.
